BackstoryDef.title: Rukaya commando
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an excellent soldier, achieving victories through superb combat skill and earning the respect of [PAWN_possessive] comrades. But only [PAWN_pronoun] knew the pressure of combat had taken a toll, and years of warfare had made [PAWN_objective] difficult to talk to.

BackstoryDef.title: Rukaya blacksmith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had once served as a blacksmith for the alliance, forging weapons for settlements without fabrication machines. [PAWN_pronoun] was not only skilled at making equipment, but also designed several improvements.

BackstoryDef.title: Rukaya homesick child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] often gazed toward the sky, wondering about the homeworld spoken of by [PAWN_possessive] elders. [PAWN_pronoun] was full of curiosity and often talked about it with others.

BackstoryDef.title: Rukaya farm child laborer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] came from a family that was part of the alliance's collective farms, and [PAWN_pronoun] worked the fields with the adults from an early age. Sometimes, [PAWN_pronoun] would use scraps found around the garrison base to make small crafts.

BackstoryDef.title: Rukaya archivist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned quickly from the books [PAWN_pronoun] read, which earned [PAWN_objective] a job in the archive and allowed [PAWN_objective] to learn even more of the archive's knowledge. Yet [PAWN_possessive] duties there also made [PAWN_objective] contemptuous of heavy labor.

BackstoryDef.title: Rukaya milker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on a farm and went to school near the livestock pens. [PAWN_pronoun] found that [PAWN_pronoun] really liked the animals there and even learned how to treat them, but that also caused [PAWN_objective] to neglect [PAWN_possessive] studies.

BackstoryDef.title: Rukaya medical student
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] attended a medical school, where [PAWN_pronoun] learned the surviving medical knowledge left after the devastation. There [PAWN_pronoun] decided to be kind and swore never to harm others in battle.
